towns.name: Kara
towns.summary: Kara (83.3S 47.1E) is the Jojiist town 'hidden deep in the Linvak Mountain Range', sitting 'proud on the hillside overlooking a calm lake'; most founders went home or died before lifestones, so the four who remain call it Kara, Sho for 'Empty', yet freely offer their homes to travellers, and the master smith of the Sho works Koujia armour by the lake (Town Network sign). It hosts an Exploration Society outpost, Archmage Kiko, the Grand Master Scriveners and the Colossus Foundry entrance. In the DAT the town is a walled terrace at z 132 (LB 0xBA17) 82 m above a lake (z 50, x<35610) at the foot of a steep wooded slope: a three-storey octagonal pagoda (top 163), an octagon hall, spire and gabled Sho houses and a gate frame a tiny plaza holding the Nullified Statue of a Shadow, the Town Network portal, the Life Stone and a glowing forge hearth, with lantern posts at the gate; a church and spire house sit on a lower terrace to the north and the settlement-portal cluster lies 250 m east.
